name: 🥢 Egg Roll in a Bowl
what: Everything inside an egg roll, stir-fried fast and served over rice.

core.name: Rainbow slaw (bag)
core.out: any coleslaw mix, or thin-sliced cabbage and carrots

extras: garlic, ginger, green onions, sesame oil, mayo + sriracha for spicy mayo

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Start the rice.
Brown the chicken in a big skillet on high. Leave it alone 4 minutes, then crumble.
Add garlic and ginger for 30 seconds. Mix soy sauce with a little sesame oil and sugar.
Add the slaw and the sauce. Toss just until wilted, still crunchy.
Serve over rice with green onions and spicy mayo for anyone who wants it.

key: High heat, short cook on the slaw. It should still crunch.
done: No pink in the meat and the slaw is bright and just soft.
plan_b: No slaw? Use any veggies we have, or just serve the meat and sauce over rice.
